receipts.title: Receipts
receipts.info: Receipts are the individual charges issued to members — membership fees, activity registrations and manual charges. They are grouped into remittances for collection by direct debit.
receipts.creditNoteAmountHint: Leave empty to credit everything still outstanding.
receipts.enterCreditNoteReason: Why is this document being rectified?
receipts.creditNoteExplainer: An issued receipt is not edited — it is rectified by a new document. {number} keeps its number and amounts, and the credit note takes the next number in the series.
receipts.generateFeesDesc: Create receipts for all active members based on their membership type
receipts.confirmEmitDescription: It gets its final number and becomes due for collection.
receipts.confirmCancelDescription: A voided receipt is not collected and cannot be reinstated. If it is already paid, a credit note is the right route.
receipts.confirmReemitDescription: It goes back to pending. Emit it again to make it available for a new batch.
receipts.authoritativeStatusNote: Final confirmation arrives from the Redsys asynchronous notification.
receipts.paymentSuccessMessage: Your payment has been processed successfully.
receipts.paymentPendingMessage: Your payment is being processed. We'll email you when confirmed.
receipts.paymentCancelMessage: Your payment was not completed. You can try again or go back.
receipts.inRemittanceSent: sent to the bank, collection in progress
